slices.title: Thread lease and workspace RPCs and tables (flag off)
slices.summary: Adds the thread-scoped lease: AcquireThread is an idempotent get-or-create per owner and thread that slides the expiry, and it refuses any space_id, non-thread scope, ZDR requests and service principals. Adds GetThreadWorkspace and ApplyThreadWorkspaceChanges with per-path base_hash compare-and-set (conflicts returned, never overwritten) and file and byte caps, and declares DeleteThreadWorkspace (implemented in S5). Adds AcquireLeaseRequest.zdr = 8, the tables thread_workspace_files and thread_workspaces, regenerated bindings and the authz rows. Every new RPC returns FailedPrecondition while SANDBOX_MANAGER_THREAD_WORKSPACE is off.
test_commands: cd 'apps/Model Plane/go/services/sandbox-manager' && go vet ./... && go test ./... && go test -tags integration ./internal/... (Docker)

Named Go tests from the Tests column: TestThreadLeaseRejectsSpaceID, TestThreadWorkspaceRPCsRefuseSpaceLease, TestSpaceManifestNeverReadsThreadRows, TestAnotherUserCannotAcquireOrReadAThreadLease, TestServicePrincipalCannotAcquireThreadLease, TestAcquireThreadIsIdempotentAndSlides, TestApplyReportsConflictWithoutOverwriting, TestApplyEnforcesQuota
Appendix B N2 in place of buf breaking: git show HEAD:'apps/Model Plane/proto/model_plane/v1/sandboxes.proto' tag-diffed against the working copy; attach the diff
Appendix B K1-24 regeneration of Go and Rust bindings: docker run --rm -v $PWD:/w -w /w bufbuild/buf generate
slices.flag: SANDBOX_MANAGER_THREAD_WORKSPACE (default empty = off; every new RPC returns FailedPrecondition while off)
